basic_info.description: Welcome to 1449 Innes Avenue, a light-filled Bayview home where sweeping downtown views meet everyday comfort. Sunlight fills generous interiors, creating a sense of openness and ease. From the living room, the skyline stretches before you, a reminder that the heart of San Francisco is always in sight.    Perched on a quiet stretch of Innes Avenue, the home enjoys exceptional vistas of the Bay, Bay Bridge, and downtown. Stroll to India Basin Shoreline Park for a morning walk, or catch the Third Street rail just a block away for a quick ride to Dogpatch. Wood-fired pizza at Piccino, cocktails at Serpentine, and coffee at Philz are all close at hand. Spend evenings with a pint at Laughing Monk Brewing, or head to Chase Center and Oracle Park for games and shows.    This is more than an address, it's a connection to San Francisco's evolving waterfront, a neighborhood on the rise, and a city whose scale always invites discovery.  San Francisco: The smallest world-class city.
